report.title: Jack-up site-specific analysis: the data list, the checks and the public accident record

code.python: 3.10 or later; pypdf with its AES extra for the NTSB check
code.install: none for the counts; pip install "pypdf[crypto]" for the NTSB check

inputs.description: 35 public events with year, unit type, location, position, hazard group and source
NTSB MIR-22/26, capsizing of the liftboat SEACOR Power
US Code of Federal Regulations quoted by the article: 46 CFR 174.240 to 174.260 (liftboats; 174.255 on-bottom stability) and 30 CFR 250.713 (air gap)
For a site assessment: latitude, longitude, water depth, soil data and the unit's data (Table 3 of the article)

missing_data.what: The site: latitude, longitude and water depth
missing_data.why: The article sets out the method for any site; it assesses none.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Give the position in decimal degrees and the charted depth; the prompt then finds public metocean and bathymetry for it.
missing_data.effect: Without it, the prompt gives the data list and the checks as a template.

missing_data.what: The unit: type (jack-up or liftboat), leg length, spudcan size, preload, lightship and variable load, air gap
missing_data.why: Unit data is not public for most units.
missing_data.how_to_supply: From the unit's operating manual or the owner of the unit.
missing_data.effect: The structural and overturning checks stay 'to be checked'.

missing_data.what: Site soil data: borehole or CPT logs at the leg positions
missing_data.effect: The punch-through check cannot be done.

missing_data.what: ISO 19905-1:2023, SNAME T&R 5-5A Rev 3 and the IMO MODU Code
missing_data.how_to_supply: A reader with copies can supply the clause text.
missing_data.effect: Clauses of these codes are cited only as the article cites them, marked 'to be checked'.

missing_data.what: A free Copernicus Climate Data Store account and API key, for ERA5 metocean data
missing_data.why: ERA5 downloads need a personal key.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Create the account and give the assistant the key in your own session.
missing_data.effect: Without it, use NOAA NDBC buoy records where a buoy is near the site.

missing_data.what: An open or closed investigation flag for each event
missing_data.why: The data set has no such column yet.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Not from the reader: a later revision of the data set adds it.
missing_data.effect: Whether an investigation is open is judged from the article text.

cannot_do: Assess a site without the reader's location, unit and soil data.
Quote clauses of ISO 19905-1, SNAME 5-5A or the MODU Code without the paid documents.
Give a world count of liftboats or of wind installation jack-ups: none was found in the cited sources.
Name a cause for an event still under investigation.
